ارتقبتما (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَبْتُمَا (irtaqabtumā) /ir.ta.qab.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# اُرْتُقِبْتُمَا (urtuqibtumā) /ur.tu.qib.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
